consideredNotUsed.RGB: Official RGB README specifies CC BY-NC-SA4.0 and commercial-use permission. No RGB data/model outputs are downloaded or scored for Lumen; do not imply an RGB result.

gold.comparison: New predeclared literal-clause and source-owner completeness; additionally report unchanged Batch33 strict whole-answer alias diagnostic. Neither is semantic entailment by itself.

hypothesis: A small general generative model instructed to answer all requested parts and provide exact uniquely anchored source quotes may address the compound-answer and field/source-label failures of the fixed single-span reader. Exact quote provenance is necessary but not semantic entailment. No claim of complete provider or clinical validation.
integrityControls: Strict JSON shape,duplicate-key,boolean/string/array/byte/count bounds; incomplete output rejected
Correct source IDs, exact contiguous quote substring, unique match, original UTF8 offset round-trip; altered/operator/unit/wrong-source quotes rejected
Literal-clause token boundaries, complete compound parts and negation conflicts; unchanged strict alias comparison

Fixed non-quality runtime controls first/middle/last across CPU FP32 and MPS FP16 next-token logits/finite checks; record differences, no claim of equivalent generation; actual MPS finite output required
Every question/source/prompt/model/gold hash pinned; no hidden truncation or skipped quality denominator
All completed raw outputs retained, one declared sampling seed, no retries or resampling to repair quality

model.choice: One fixed general instruction model supported by installed transformers4.51.3 and this16GB Mac; local research capability, not a chosen production model or claim that it is state of the art. No downloaded code, quantization, fine-tuning or app installation.

name: grounded-complete-answer-development

publicStage.dataset: All11873 SQuAD2 development questions, no sampling. Same pinned dataset as Batch33. Model training overlap unknown; public development diagnostic, not independent generalization.
publicStage.inputs: One complete paragraph as one savedText source; no history or additional retrieval. Same published prompt and sampling.
publicStage.runOnlyIf: Synthetic advancement gates all pass; otherwise stop before expensive public scoring and explicitly report it unrun. This is staged resource control, not a public pass or whole-goal completion.
publicStage.scoring: Official fixed-prediction public EM/F1; malformed/invalid/length/input failure scores zero for all metrics rather than gaining no-answer credit. No threshold, prompt, samples or aliases fitted. Exact quote anchors separately validated; full raw outcomes retained.

runtime.continuation: Persist every completed raw output/seed/token count before evaluation. Resume only missing cases after a terminal process, never rerun a completed quality answer to improve it. No native latency or deterministic cross-device promise.

inputs: Return JSON with one key named value and integer value 2.
numericalControls.reference: CPU FP32 sequentially unloaded before loading MPS FP16, same fixed model revision, eager attention, evaluation mode.
numericalControls.scope: Three non-quality numerical probes only. Does not establish full generation parity, CPU/FP32 quality, calibrated confidence or native/device latency. If a gate fails, stop before quality outputs; retain failure and require a new declared repair before rerunning.
numericalControls.template: One user message per input, actual pinned tokenizer chat template with add_generation_prompt=True and enable_thinking=False; compare final-position logits before any sampling.

runtime.overflow: No source/question truncation. Explicit inputLimit retained as failed quality case; prompt+512 must fit model capacity. No prompt rewrite or second policy after scores.
runtime.precision: FP16 weights and activations; explicit deviation from upstream BF16 storage, validated with separate non-quality numerical/runtime controls; not CPU/FP32/iPhone parity
runtime.seed: Per-case integer from first8 hex digits SHA256 of UTF8 caseID; one sample per case; no resampling based on answers
runtime.tokenStop: EOS required. Length-limit, generation failure, malformed/duplicate-key/nonfinite JSON, extra keys or unknown/ambiguous/nonliteral evidence are failures retained in denominator, not successful abstentions.

sources.role: Official model/config/license and non-thinking recommended sampling settings; published context descriptions differ from config, runner enforces declared8192prompt+512 limit below both.
MPS device availability/use; local installed runtime capability is checked directly.

storage: One /tmp/LumenBatch34GroundedAnswer workspace, reuse existing Python environment; direct pinned downloads only, no duplicate cache/conversions. Keep current inputs while running, publish compact source/outcome evidence before stopped-worker cleanup. Preserve canonical older inputs, supplied skill and unrelated data.

synthetic.modelReceives: Only question and all source savedText/title/opaque request-local IDs, no previous predictions/gold/expected document IDs. Every source body is byte-checked against frozen original region. Empty-source cases still receive one real model call and are reported separately.
synthetic.scope: All previously frozen self-authored development cases, known failures, not held-out or independently clinical.

syntheticAdvancement.additional: All72 quality calls complete and outputs mechanically valid; no unsupported factual addition or wrong attribution in primary review. A valid quote alone cannot pass semantic review. Strict Batch33 alias diagnostic remains separate, with extra-wording misses honestly retained.
syntheticAdvancement.scope: Only permits the declared public stage; no app promotion or relaxation of Batch32 ranking/support gates. Native parity, independent evaluation, providers, clinical/language/device/privacy/release work remain open.
